name: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
review: My first Andy Weir book. A great sci-fi adventure. It felt like I was right there with Grace figuring out what was going on, and somehow feeling just as smart as the character about the clever scientific solutions employed (just because I understood them). I love when a sci-fi book makes it feel like everything would be 'technically' possible, and this one does that to great effect.
